description: The British Geological Survey publishes manually digitised magnetograms from Lerwick, Eskdalemuir and Hartland for the March 1946 and August 1972 geomagnetic storms. Its repository also identifies an October 2003 Eskdalemuir record. These are selected events, not continuous coverage; the catalogue date field omits the 2003 addition. Engauge extracted the traces, which were checked against hourly World Data Centre values. The provider supplies IAGA-2002 files through its accession service under the Open Government Licence, with a Natural Environment Research Council acknowledgement. Access is free. Sampling details should be checked before combining individual traces. The observations can validate space-weather simulations and historical scenarios of geomagnetically induced currents in electricity networks. They complement data-bgs-geomagnetism-observatory-data-and-indices with this specific digital storm reconstruction; that parent already covers the scanned archive.
